title: Otori Emu — Beware Of Thieves!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Mikazukigumi Practice Area

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Sorry, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I feel terrible about having our farewell party here since it's supposed to be a special occasion...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, that's not a problem!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It isn't your fault that the place you usually go to was closed due to an emergency... We're just glad to be here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Plus, we owe you and your troupe so much for letting us train here! This place has a special place in our hearts now!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Thank you for saying that.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Alright, then...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Today, we have to say farewell to Wonderlands×Showtime! So, let's give them a proper send-off!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Tsukasa, Rui & Nene
rows.Line:
Cheeers!
Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: On top of everything we got from the deli, we splurged on pizza and sushi! Feel free to have as much as you like!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay, pizza♪
Let's dig in!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll have some as well! Ow, hot!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: S-Slow down, you two. That pizza's still scalding hot.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, there's so much here. Chili prawns, Salisbury steaks, omelets, fried chicken... I don't know where to begin.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I'm gonna have some of this sushi next☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, Emu, you've already finished eating that pizza?! But it's molten hot!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. It was so good that I had to gobble it up whole♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew... I'm stuffed...

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
I'm glad you enjoyed everything.
Here, have some tea.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, thank you!
I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: But you two still seem hungry, Otori, Tenma...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I've still got plenty of room left in my tummy!!!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! I like your spirit!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But we really need to thank you again for throwing us a farewell party like this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We learned a lot from all of you. We owe you a great debt.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
No, we should also be thanking you.
The performances we did together were so fun and eye-opening!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: And we certainly wouldn't have been able to catch the thief that was terrorizing Hiori Jidaigeki Studio Park without all of you.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: He's right. We honestly couldn't believe it when we saw you up on top of that fire tower, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, you saw me?!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: Just when we were thinking that it'd be nice to have an eye in the sky, we noticed you up there...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
That was a great idea!
We wouldn't have been able to catch that thief without your plan, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad I was able to help♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I didn't come up with that idea! A friend of mine did! I'll make sure to thank her the next chance I get!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
I see!
Still, your vision must be really good since you were able to pick out individual people from that high up.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, it really is incredible...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Right, I was also amazed by that!
I didn't know anyone could see that far without using a pair of binoculars!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. My vision's always been super good!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: You're also really athletic, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: I know, right?! We thought we'd gotten used to that sort of thing looking at our leader, but you just kept finding new ways to surprise us...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Emu's always surprising us as well.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Is that true?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. You're always somersaulting down from these tall trees!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And you dodged everyone's attacks with ease during our sword fighting practices. Plus, you're really fast.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
Everyone's showering me with praise!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's more where that came from.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: When we got stranded on that island, you were the first one to find us berries and bananas.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: S-Stranded...?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah...!
Sounds like you all had yourselves an interesting adventure!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Shosuke told me a little about all of you, but you really are a fun bunch of kids.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I wish we could spend some more time together since it really felt like you were constantly surprising us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wish we could stay longer too...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You had me on the edge of my seat every time I saw you play a character, Mr. Kijima...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Now I really wanna learn how to put on those kinds of performances!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: That makes me really happy.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: As long as we all keep on acting, I'm sure we'll cross paths again someday.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: So, I'll be looking forward to the day we meet again!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna practice lots and lots to make sure I blow you guys away the next time we meet!!!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Ah, we'll certainly be looking forward to that!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(They're all so nice...
And I learned so much from them.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I have to make the most of what they taught me!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Because I wanna make as many people as I can smile from ear to ear!)
